verdict.rationale: Godot imports any asset placed in the project folder automatically, with no per-file clicking, and lets you change import parameters on several assets at once. It also documents import plugins as a first-class editor extension point for custom import handling, and EditorScripts plus the headless CLI support scripted editor automation. missing for 10: documented import presets/default-per-type settings, post-import processing hooks for standard formats (e.g. scene post-import scripts), explicit evidence of headless/CI-driven reimport, independent hands-on corroboration of pipeline automation.
